title: Billy Joel Tribute Booklet

card.teaser: Sixteen pages on Billy Joel and Vienna, in cream, charcoal and burgundy.

summary: Sixteen pages on Billy Joel's songwriting, especially Vienna, in cream, charcoal and burgundy.
meta: 16-page booklet, typography and layout, colour system

hero.alt: A Billy Joel tribute booklet lying on dark wooden slats.

overview.challenge: Capture the reflective feel of Billy Joel's songwriting, especially Vienna, in print.
overview.solution: A late-1970s palette of cream, charcoal and burgundy, archival-feeling references, and a structure that gives the music room to breathe.
overview.outcome: A 16-page booklet that works as both a tribute and an editorial reading of the songs.
